verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Extract supports dragging and dropping a document into the LlamaParse web UI to extract data, Extract is offered as a web UI, and Parse jobs can be run from the Web UI. That covers the core of a no-code playground for trying documents before writing code. However, the drag-and-drop-then-view-results flow is only documented for Extract, and one community user found the interface confusing because table output did not appear in tabular form. missing for 10: explicit documentation of drag-and-drop with result preview for Parse (not just Extract), detail on how results are displayed in the playground, positive independent hands-on corroboration of the web playground experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: Just define your Extraction Configuration (schema and settings), drag and drop any supported document into LlamaParse and extract data from your documents.
Extract is available as a web UI, Python SDK and REST API.
Get your first parse job running in under a minute—whether you prefer Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, the CLI, the REST API, or the Web UI.
